extension.description: Edit Qt UI files using the Python environment selected in VS Code and automatically generate PySide6 code.
workspaceTrust.description: Requires running Qt tools from the Python environment selected for the project.
command.editUi.title: Edit QT UI File
configuration.uic.options.description: Arguments passed to PySide6 uic, with one argument per array element and no extra quotes. Supports path variables such as `${resourceDirname}`, `${resourceBasenameNoExtension}`, `${workspaceFolder}`, `${pathSeparator}`, and `${env:NAME}`. Relative paths are resolved against the UI file's directory.
Automatically generate Python files when .ui files are created or saved, including saves from external Designer.
